high_level_description: stc brand style, a split night view of an oil refinery and an offshore oil platform, both overlaid with connectivity icons and a satellite formation in the sky.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Two nighttime industrial panels side by side: an oil refinery with a tall flare stack on the left, and an offshore drilling platform over dark water on the right, both under starry skies with satellites flying overhead.

elements.desc: A row of satellites with solar panels flying in formation across the night sky.
White line-art icons overlaid on the scene including a shield, a globe/WiFi signal icon, and a cloud icon, connected by dashed lines.
